title: Gov't approves Jin Air's merger with Air Seoul, Air Busan
caption:
South Korea cleared the way for Jin Air, Air Seoul and Air Busan to join forces, creating a 58‑aircraft low‑cost carrier. The new airline could reshape domestic travel, though it still awaits shareholder votes. Stay tuned for how this reshapes the budget‑flight market.

Source: En - Gov't approves Jin Air's merger with Air Seoul, Air Busan
